Meet the Founder

The vision behind Aperant Services

Akudo Oghenero Sabastine

Founder & Chief Executive Officer

Business Automation Financial Intelligence AI Systems Lagos, Nigeria

Akudo Oghenero Sabastine is the founder and CEO of Aperant Services Limited, a Lagos-based business automation company dedicated to helping Nigerian businesses eliminate manual financial processes and scale efficiently using AI-powered systems.

With deep expertise in financial modelling, invoice automation, and operational intelligence, Akudo built Aperant to bridge the gap between enterprise-grade automation and the everyday Nigerian business owner.

"Every Nigerian business deserves systems that work as hard as they do. We built Aperant to make that possible — without the complexity."

— Akudo Oghenero Sabastine, Founder & CEO

What We Offer

Four pillars of business automation

We build systems that do the repetitive work for you — accurately, instantly, and at scale.

🧾

Invoice Automation

Generate, send, and track invoices automatically. No more manual chasing — reminders, confirmations, and payment records handled for you.

📊

Budgeting & Financial Modelling

Dynamic budget models that update in real time. Forecast scenarios, set spend limits, and get automatic alerts before you exceed thresholds.

💰

Income & Expense Tracking

Capture every naira — from receipt photos to bank entries. Live view of your financial position across projects, departments, or locations.

🚀

Business Scaling Systems

Operational frameworks and automation infrastructure to grow your business without growing your headcount.

Our Process

Up and running in days, not months

You focus on your business while we set everything up.

01

Discovery Call

We learn your current processes, pain points, and what you want automated first. No jargon, just a clear conversation.

02

Custom Build

We design and build automation systems tailored to your business — your tools, your data, your workflow.

03

Test & Handover

We test everything thoroughly, train your team, and hand over a system that works from day one.

04

Ongoing Support

As your business grows, we scale and adapt your systems to match your new needs.
